name: CVEL Proton-K

description: Proton-K three-stage launcher with split payload fairing and a payload port. Converted from the CVEL Orbiter add-on (code D. Henderson, stage 2 Urwumpe, stages 1 and 3 Alex v Hohlov; meshes Artistic Licence). Stage 1 and 2 engine data from the original; vacuum isp only.
